summary: Carry current B12X master into beta: shared Trellis/EXL3 expert preparation with full-codeword K2 decoding
compatibility: No user action required. The beta keeps version 1.3.0, which vLLM's b12x extra pins; master's 1.5.0 release bump is not carried.
details: Uniform EXL3 and native Trellis experts share one preparation path, and prepared K2 Trellis decoding looks up full codewords (b12x #436). It removes the 82.56 tok/s regression of the uniform two-bit Kimi-K3 EXL3 checkpoint with unchanged acceptance.
The same sync brings FP32 dense-MLA split partials as an explicit option (b12x #441) and retained Trellis route-pack programs (b12x #442), described in their own notes.
